title: S7ar SMP
description: The modpack for the small smp ran by S7ARLAZER and maintained by Me
body:
The pack has a emphesis on exploration, using Terralith and Distant horizons at its core, you will be able to see and explore an expansive and diverse world. A variety of structure mods help to add life to every corner of the world.

While staying true to the vanilla feel, this pack enhances your journey with many quality-of-life improvements, decorative elements, and new creatures, making any adventure more immersive without straying too far from a classic experiance. 

## Installation
The .mrpack file provided is suitable for both client and server environments, installation through the Modrinth launcher or a launcher capable of handling .mrpack files will install all the mods required for a client, while using tools like mrpack-install will install the pack for use on a server. More information can be found on the oficial [Modpacks on modrinth](https://support.modrinth.com/en/articles/8802250-modpacks-on-modrinth) page.

### About
The pack was initially made by s7arlazer for use on an smp. The pack has now been passed onto me to maintain, update, and release for use by members of the server and others.
